name: attestwire/attestwire-php
description: Create and validate EN 16931 e-invoices (XRechnung, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD PDFs, Peppol BIS 3) with the hosted Attestwire API. Includes an adapter for horstoeko/invoicesuite's validator so its users can validate without a Java KoSIT install.

suggest.horstoeko/invoicesuite: Enables Attestwire\InvoiceSuite\AttestwireDocumentValidator, a drop-in EN 16931 validator for horstoeko/invoicesuite (same abstract base as its own KoSIT and DocuFlair validators) — validate without a Java KoSIT install. Needs PHP >=8.2 (invoicesuite's own floor) and is deliberately NOT a require-dev of this package: composer install must succeed on this package's own PHP >=8.1 floor with nothing extra. Add it yourself — `composer require --dev horstoeko/invoicesuite:'>=0.0.30'` — to also exercise tests/InvoiceSuite/AttestwireDocumentValidatorTest.php; it self-skips otherwise.
